title: Ripping Off the Lies of the Devil with Pastor Chris Zehner
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals the truth about Satan's lies and how they affect our lives, and learn how to break free from the bondage of negative thought patterns and false identities. Through Scripture and personal experience, Pastor Chris will show you how to stand against the enemy's tactics and take back the power and authority that is rightfully yours. Don't miss this powerful sermon as Pastor Chris Zehner helps you discover your true identity in Christ and walk in victory over Satan's lies.
